lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy4Ag12Ni4 (DyAg3Ni) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 geometric neighbors (4 Ag, 4 Ni, 4 Dy), Dy centers with 16 neighbors (8 Ag, 8 Ni), and Ni centers with 12 neighbors (4 Ag, 8 Ni). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ag 12-vertex and Ni 12-vertex polyhedra, plus corner and face sharing between Dy 16-vertex and Ni 12-vertex polyhedra.
